title: Downtown Miami Art Week 2026 Artist Registration
organizer: Les Couleurs Art Gallery / Aura Copeland Gallery / Mana Common
location: Downtown Miami, East Flagler Street (three galleries)
event_dates: VIP Preview Nov 30, 2026; Public Exhibition Dec 1–6, 2026
fee: Yes – wall space reservation fee (check MoonClerk link for current amount)
fee_reason: Covers professional multi-gallery curated presentation, installation, VIP preview access, and sales support during peak Miami Art Week in historic Flagler District
eligibility: Emerging and established artists worldwide; physical work preferred
looking_for: Original contemporary visual art (painting, sculpture, mixed media, etc.)
questions_approx: Registration form (space size, contact, basic info) – ~5–8 fields
materials_required: Physical artwork delivery + inventory sheet + photos of each piece + printed labels (name/title/medium/dims/price) + hanging hardware. Typically 1–several pieces.
includes_entry: Yes – participation in the exhibition and access to VIP preview / public hours
google_search: Downtown Miami Art Week 2026 artist registration lescouleurs
notes: Sponsored by Mana Common. Curated by Gabrielly Paz. Delivery windows were Nov 5–15 historically – confirm.
